items.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
items.summary: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life
items.summary: Jensen Huang likely left Nvidia more because of risky business practices than anything else, a Wall Street Journal report suggests. At the very least, those practices made him enemies internally. The company offered cloud providers billions in financial guarantees for chip purchases, including a planned $250 billion deal with OpenAI. items.title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. items.title: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
items.summary: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway. The article Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
items.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. items.title: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
items.summary: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. items.title: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
items.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. The agent already has over 10 million users, according to Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang. Google Gemini, Instinct, and xAI's Grok Bot offer the same feature, but many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI on the line.
